notes.title: Nominate Virt-U-Mate for the sit and relax award on Steam
notes.notes:
It's already that time of year again, for the nominations of the Steam Players Choice Awards. We'd like to encourage all players that enjoyed Virt-U-Mate to nominate our game for the Adult Game of the Year. 

We have been working hard to address all players issues and make improvements to the game, including UI changes, control issues and graphical improvements to the game throughout it's release. We hope that you've enjoyed these ongoing enhancements and looked forward to see where the game is going. 

Additionally we've been diligent at adding new and exciting content to the game to ensure that players feel there is a ongoing and continual effort to improve the game play experience and listen to our community to make the game even better. 

Please consider our game nomination to help support further development of both this game and adult game content on Steam now and in the future. We would appreciate any and all suggestions to help make the content on Steam even better and more exciting that it's even been.

notes.title: Touchdown Girls New CG Visual Novel Game Announcement
notes.notes:
Today we are officially announcing our newest upcoming NSFW 18+ video game, Touchdown Girls.

The story follows an up-and-coming college football player, Mike Mueller, eager to become the starting quarterback for the Brigham Hornets. Along the way, he will discover the ins and outs of Brigham University as well as earn the affection from the student body including 6 beautiful women. Touchdown Girls is a CG visual novel that contains detailed 3D rendered environments including study halls, libraries, classrooms, 100,000 seat football stadium, locker rooms, student dorms and of course secret sororities. Progress through the story to unlock special high resolution centerfold and still galleries of all the Touchdown Girls.

Touchdown Girls features an epic story, spanning hours of detailed narrative, with fully animated scenes along the way. Become immersed in a sexy, yet compelling story with many twists and turns that will keep you wanting more. Each of the female characters in the game includes a NSFW 18+ fully animated sex scene that moves the story forward are rewards you for uncovering the secrets of Brigham University.

notes.title: Curse of Black Bone Mac OS edition to be added at launch
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that Curse of Black Bone will now have a parallel Mac OS edition release at launch. We've long been supporters of both PC and Mac gamers and we're very excited that development on Black Bone has progressed to the point that we can now list both platforms on our store page.

To celebrate this update, we're uploaded an updated game trailer that includes additional fixed shots and more professional voice acting that was left out of the earlier game promo trailers. The latest trailer more accurately reflects the ongoing development of the title as we improve polish for our release date and address bugs that are being reported by our beta team.

We've been steadily moving up the 'Adult Only' upcoming charts and have now reached the #2 position. We strive to make a unique and exciting adult VN adventure and are very much looking to getting the game in players hands on September 1.

notes.title: Curse of Black Bone pre-release Announcement
notes.notes:
In celebration of our new Steam listing, we are starting to send out early pre-release Beta copies of Curse of Black Bone to curators and influencers. This early version of the game does not contain the game ending that will be included in the final retail version of the game that goes on sale September 1, 2022.

What is included in the Beta pre-release is 80% of the High Definition CG animations, 3D explorable gameplay and interactive characters. While we are still making improvements and tweaks to all parts of the game before it's Early Access release, there is still hours of content and movies that can already be unlocked for these early players.

We look forward to building our fan base and hearing about how curators are enjoying the game before it's release. As always, comments and suggestions can be made in our community forums as we will be monitoring them while we receive this early feedback.

notes.title: Male Puppet Patch - Update v1.54.1
notes.notes:
Male Puppet Patch - Update v1.54

This update patch for Virt-U-Mate includes newly added full bone weight puppet control to the Male character that works in conjunction with the newly added Male sexual position animations. 

We have also fixed the AO map issue with the male character so that his crotch skin rendering matches the rest of the skin tone without any unwanted shadows.

notes.title: iOS Patch Update v1.54.1
notes.notes:
In the last animation update patch we made an error resulting in the iOS version of Virt-U-Mate build being updated with 0 bytes. This error has been resolved and the iOS build Update v1.54.1 now correctly matches the Windows version already available online. 

Thanks to users who reported this error with the MAC build.

notes.title: New Sex Position Animations Added - Update v1.54
notes.notes:
New Sex Position Animations Added - Update v1.54

Many users mentioned that positioning of the Male character with the IK rigs was too cumbersome and required difficult setup for interaction with the Female partner. In light on this, we're added a complete Male animation set that can be selected from the position menu to better help with quick and easy positioning and interactions with both characters. 

We'll be looking to make IK adjustments an option for both characters, but for now this will make the game more enjoyable for all and much easier to use and get the results in scene that most players are looking for. 

All new positions are located in the Actress position menu when the Male character has been activated in the Visual Settings menu.

notes.title: Virt-U-Mate Update v1.5.3 - Character major performance enhancement upgrade
notes.notes:
Virt-U-Mate Update v1.5.3 - Character major performance enhancement upgrade

This major performance enhancement upgrades all in game characters for better framerates and overall performance. Players will see vastly improved CPU and playback performance when using physics based clothing and hair. 

Some environment improvements have been made to further optimize playback on all devices.
